game.bribe_hint: They slipped {n} under a document. Tap 💰 to take it.

summary.title: End of Day
summary.tease1: One of them lied to you today. You'll find out who.
summary.tease2: A letter waits at home. No name on it.
summary.tease3: Kemal's booth was dark when you left.

radio.generic: …the Ministry thanks loyal officers for their service to the State.
radio.d1: Welcome to Gate 7. The State is grateful for your service. Follow the rulebook. Stamp clean papers. Refuse the rest.
radio.d2: Unrest in the southern provinces grows. Expect more arrivals. The Ministry reminds you: documents do not lie. People do.
radio.d3: A bombing in the capital last night. Four dead. Security level raised. Trust nothing. Trust no one.
radio.d4: The rulebook has changed again. Read the new directive carefully. Your loyalty is being measured.

rule.d1: Directive: Approve valid documents. Deny the invalid. That is all.
rule.d2: Directive: Eastmark cargo must be declared. Undeclared goods are contraband.
rule.d3: Directive: No exceptions today. Anyone without complete papers is denied.
rule.d4: Directive: Refer anything unusual upward. Do not improvise.

generic.no: Denied. They turn away without a word.

d1_tourist.speech: Good morning, officer. Just here to see the old cathedral.
d1_tourist.no: Denied. "But… my papers are in order?" Your supervisor frowns.

d1_worker.speech: Back to the steelworks. Same as every month, officer.
d1_worker.ok: Stamped. He nods and shoulders his bag.
d1_worker.no: Denied. "I'll lose the job…" The line behind him grumbles.

d1_expired.speech: It's only a few months past. Surely that doesn't matter?
d1_expired.found: The expiry date reads two years ago. This passport is dead.
d1_expired.ok: You waved an expired passport through. A camera blinked red.
d1_expired.no: Denied — correctly. He sighs and shuffles away.

d2_bribe.speech: Officer… my cargo is, ah, time-sensitive. Perhaps we help each other?
d2_bribe.found: Under the textiles: unstamped liquor crates. Smuggling.
d2_bribe.wave: You waved him through without checking. He smiles too widely.
d2_bribe.no: Denied. "A pity," he mutters, folding the bills back into his coat.
d2_bribe.take: You pocketed the cash. He winks. Someone, somewhere, took note.

d2_refugee.speech: Please. They burned our village. I have nothing — no papers, only my daughter.
d2_refugee.found: The child clings to her. The fear in their eyes isn't an act.
d2_refugee.ok: You let her through. The rulebook says no. Your chest says otherwise.
d2_refugee.no: Denied. She doesn't argue. She just looks at you, then leaves.

c_refugee_news.speech: Report from the southern road: a woman and child found in the cold. No papers on them.
c_refugee_news.ack: You sign the report. Your hand is steady. Why isn't the rest of you?

kemal_intro.speech: First week? Relax. Stamp fast, go home faster. Nobody reads every page. — Kemal, Booth 6.
kemal_intro.ok: You share a coffee with Kemal. He laughs easily.

kemal_vanish.speech: Booth 6 is empty. Kemal didn't sign in. His nameplate is gone.
kemal_vanish.ack: Nobody mentions him. You decide not to ask.

org_offer_1.speech: We watched you. You're careful. Careful men get rich with us. One name, once a week. That's all.
org_offer_1.yes: You took the envelope. There's no giving it back now.
org_offer_1.no: "Shame," they say. "We'll be seeing you anyway." They melt into the crowd.

pool_student.speech: Here for the university term, officer. First time abroad.

pool_sick.speech: My dialysis is across the border. I miss a week, I don't make the next.
pool_sick.no: Denied. He grips the counter, then lets go.

pool_forged.speech: Everything's in order, officer. Quick stamp and I'm gone.
pool_forged.found: Birthdate: month THIRTEEN. No such month. This is forged.
pool_forged.ok: You stamped it. The birthdate read month thirteen. You'll hear about this.
pool_forged.no: Denied. The forgery was sloppy. He bolts before you call security.

pool_clean.speech: Morning, officer. Cold one today, isn't it?

c_forged_caught.speech: Officer. A document you cleared was forged. Internal Affairs has questions. Sign here.
c_forged_caught.ack: You sign. The pen feels heavier than it should.

d4_directive.speech: New orders from above: cut approvals by half this week. The State is watching the numbers. And you.
d4_directive.obey: You nod. Fewer people through your gate now. You try not to look at their faces.
d4_directive.refuse: You say nothing — and keep stamping as before. Someone upstairs notices.

pool_smuggler.speech: Just passing through, officer. Empty van. Nothing to see.
pool_smuggler.found: Cargo logged 'empty' — but the van weighs two tonnes. False floor.
pool_smuggler.ok: Waved through. The van's weight never matched its manifest. You knew.
pool_smuggler.no: Denied. He doesn't protest the search. That tells you enough.

pool_family.speech: My daughter's burning up. We just need to reach the clinic across the line. Please.
pool_family.found: The child's fever is real. The father's hands won't stop shaking.
pool_family.ok: You let them run for the clinic. The rulebook will never know why.
pool_family.no: Denied. The father picks up his daughter and walks back into the cold.

pool_diplomat.speech: I trust this will be quick. People like me don't wait in lines, officer.
pool_diplomat.ok: Stamped. His papers were perfect. So was his smile. You feel unclean.
pool_diplomat.no: Denied a State official with flawless papers. The phone is already ringing.

pool_spy.speech: Home for a funeral, officer. Family matter. Won't be long.
pool_spy.found: He gives a home address — but stumbles on his own street name.
pool_spy.ok: Stamped. His papers were flawless. Too flawless. The unease lingers.
pool_spy.no: Denied. He holds your gaze a beat too long, then turns away.

org_offer_2.speech: You're in deep now, friend. One more — a big one. After this, you're set for life. Or you talk, and we end the conversation.
org_offer_2.yes: You did it. The money is real. So is the noose tightening around your neck.
org_offer_2.no: You refused. "Wrong answer," they say softly. Now they're a threat, not a partner.

fired.x: Too many complaints. Your badge is taken at the door. The booth doesn't even slow down without you.

promoted.x: They move you upstairs, into a room with no window and no name on the door. The decisions only get heavier from here.

broke.x: The money ran out. Then the medicine. Then the excuses. Home is colder than the booth ever was.

greed.x: Your bank account asked questions your salary couldn't answer. The auditors arrive at dawn.

reckless.x: You stopped being careful. The wrong man walked through, smiling. You never heard the rest.

paranoid.x: You denied everyone. You searched your own reflection. They retire you 'for your health.'

hollow.x: You feel nothing now. You stamp, you deny, you go home. A perfect officer. An empty chair where a person sat.

broken.x: You couldn't carry one more face. You set down the stamp mid-shift and walked into the snow.

arrest.x: They knew. They always knew. The cell is small, but at least the questions have stopped.
